hook: Have you ever wondered why Python is taking the world by storm?
intro: Hello! Welcome to Python Basics. In this episode we will learn what Python is, how to install it, and write our very first program.

sections.title: Why Python?
sections.script: Python is one of the most popular programming languages in the world. It reads almost like English. It is used for websites, data science, and automation.
key_points: Used for web, data science and automation

diagrams.name: python_vs_languages
diagrams.description: Comparison of Python vs other languages

sections.title: Installing Python
sections.script: Let's install Python. Head to python dot org and download the installer. Remember to tick add Python to PATH.

outro: Great job! Subscribe for Episode 2, where we learn about variables.
